### Google Group

JARNet uses a Google Group to share information about research meetings, seminars, funding opportunities, calls, and networking events. To keep the list useful and prevent spam, membership requests are reviewed before approval.

#### How to Join

1. Sign in with your Google account and request membership using the link below.

    👉 **[JARNet Google Group](https://groups.google.com/g/ja-researchers-in-at/about)**

2. In your request, please include:
    - Your name
    - Your affiliation and position, such as PhD student, researcher, or industry researcher
    - Your contact email address


#### Posting Guidelines

- Posts related to research, education, and academic exchange are welcome.
- Please avoid posts whose sole purpose is commercial promotion.
- If your post includes personal information, please handle it responsibly and with appropriate care.


#### Leaving the List

- You can leave the group from the Google Groups management page. If anything is unclear, please contact us via [Contact](contact.qmd).
